learned: 2026-10-05, agent pass: the New York page (one of four state pages under 'Products by State') has 32 server-rendered cards: 14 cartridges at 1000 mg, 12 all-in-ones at 2000 mg, 6 at 4000 mg.
notes: Elementor page with a custom widget: each product is <article class="bnz-card" data-location="new-york" data-type="cartridges|all-in-one" data-strain data-strength="1000-mg">, name in h3.bnz-card__title, size in span.bnz-card__mg ('1000 mg', read as 1g for a vape). The other states are /colorado/, /nevada/, /new-mexico/; data-location is checked too.

Titles are bare strain names repeated per format, so the format comes from data-type. The cards link only to /find-shops/, so there is no product URL; the entry id is the strain, kept apart by format and size.
Not on the NY page (2026-10-05): the new 1G Live Resin 510 'Live Series' carts stores sell (Strawberry Sherbet).

2026-10-08 curation: 4000 mg all-in-ones are real single devices (package photo Maui-Wowie-4G: '4,000 mg All In One Vape'; Hoodie Analytics lists 'Northern Lights Disposables 4000 Mg'). Milk & Cookies and Peppermint Kush are seasonal and sold only as carts, so the missing all-in-one half is the brand's design. Live Series (1g live resin wood-tip carts, rotating strains) is a line on the CO/NV pages; stores spell Maui Wowie 'Mowie Wowie'.

skip.why: Live Series cards are rotating placeholders titled by lineage ('Live Series Sativa'), not strain products (CO/NV pages, 2026-10-08); the NY page has a Live Series filter but no cards yet. Store products of the line take line 'Live Series' from data/product_lines.json.
